protocol: 10 expanding chronological OOT windows ([50%, 100%] of deduplicated 29D ULB)
methodological_notes: All 5 models evaluated on identical expanding chronological OOT windows (no random-split leakage).
SVM (RBF) trained on all window frauds + 15,000 randomly sampled legitimate transactions for O(N^2) tractability.
Precision, Recall, F1, and MCC are computed at the fixed 0.20% operational alert budget per window.
